notes.whyBase: Added as a second external chain in place of BNB Smart Chain, whose testnet faucet could not be accessed. This is a scope change: the V1 spec lists Ethereum and BNB, with Base as post-V1. BSC is not removed — it stays defined and gated.
notes.funding: Base Sepolia has no accessible faucet either, but it is an OP-stack L2: 0.005 ETH was bridged from Sepolia through the canonical L1StandardBridge (0xfd0Bf71F60660E2f608ed56e1659C450eB113120, verified via otherBridge() == the 0x42...0010 L2 predeploy). Deposit took roughly 8 minutes to appear on L2.
notes.gas: Base Sepolia gas is ~0.006 gwei against Sepolia's ~1.1. The identical warp route deployment cost 0.0000389 ETH here versus 0.0068 ETH on Sepolia — about 175x less.
notes.distinctAsset: base-sepolia-mockusdc is a DIFFERENT asset from sepolia-mockusdc. Same ticker, different canonical issuance, different collateral pool, different synthetic on Ark (MockUSDCb). They are never merged.
notes.provenance: mailbox, merkleTreeHook, validatorAnnounce and staticMessageIdMultisigIsmFactory are Hyperlane's canonical Base Sepolia deployment. `deployer` refers only to the arkOutbound* / mockUsdc* entries.

roundTrip.outboundNeededNoNewValidators: Ark -> Base was secured by the SAME three validators already watching Ark. Adding an external chain costs a new ISM on that chain, not a new validator set — only the inbound direction needs a set per origin.
issuesHit: Base Sepolia's Mailbox rejects non-zero msg.value ('MerkleTreeHook: no value expected'). quoteGasPayment returns 0 here where Sepolia returns 1 wei, so hardcoding a fee across chains would have failed. Always quote per chain.
sepolia.base.org rate-limits an indexing agent hard enough to stall delivery entirely. Fixed by listing base-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com first with sepolia.base.org as fallback.

guard.status: LIVE — collateral router gated on both directions
guard.wiring: The mockUsdcCollateralRouter now uses guardHook as its post-dispatch hook (outbound: locking collateral) and guardIsm as its ISM (inbound: releasing it). guardIsm wraps the existing multisig, so validator verification is unchanged.
guard.liveVerification: A 100-unit transfer returns a message id; a 2,000-unit transfer reverts with ExceedsPerTransaction (0x9f6ddf1c).
